title: IntakeAssessment
description: The PCA intake classifier's LOGGED decision. Written to agent_outputs (output_type='intake_assessment') FIRST on every run, regardless of branch, BEFORE any clarification_brief. It is the auditable record of WHY PCA proceeded directly, asked clarification questions, or blocked the lifecycle. The ask/skip/block decision is grounded in per-field coverage of the Clarification Brief contract.

intake_package.description: The canonical Intake Package embedded for audit. Validated in full against intake-package.schema.json at assembly time; carried here so the whole intake->decision chain is one inspectable record.

field_coverage.description: One row per required Clarification Brief field (problem_statement, target_user, proposed_scope, success_criteria, ...) plus the handoff. Drives the decision.

evidence.description: What in the intake supports (or fails to support) this field.

completeness.description: Fraction of contract fields confidently derivable.

context_confidence.description: Confidence the product grounding fits this intake.

blocking_gaps.description: Contract fields that cannot be satisfied from the intake. Empty on proceed_direct. Each becomes a clarification question on the clarify branch.

decision.description: proceed_direct = synthesize final brief, no questions. clarify = ask the blocking_gaps, then Pass B. block = intake too thin; lifecycle clarification_blocked, no brief.

rationale.description: Human-readable justification of the decision; visible in the dashboard before the lifecycle advances.

draft_brief.description: clarify branch only: the provisional Clarification Brief shown in the dashboard while awaiting answers. NOT a clarification_brief artifact - that is written only when final (post-Pass-B).
